name: Simulator: one-off charges bill with the renewal, discounted and taxed; a coupon never discounts a one-off credit (S133, S137)
description: R25. A one-off invoice item joins the subscription's next invoice, where its coupon and tax apply; a negative item (a credit) is not discounted. Amounts are hand-derived and verified in Stripe test clocks.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, click 'Simulator' in the top navigation bar, and choose 'S133' in the 'Load scenario' dropdown
Assert the badge reads '✅ Matches golden expected' and Invoice 1 totals $65.18
Assert Invoice 2 (2027-02-01) has lines $10.00 and $79.00, a discount of -$22.25, tax of $6.68, and totals $73.43
Assert Invoice 2 (2027-02-01) has lines $20.00, -$10.00 and $79.00, a discount of -$24.75 (25% of $99.00, not of $89.00), and totals $64.25
